technical.title: Camera, radar, and LiDAR sensor fusion enhances autonomous vehicle perception systems
technical.summary: Autonomous vehicles need robust perception under diverse environments, motivating advanced fusion algorithms that combine high-resolution cameras, reliable HD radar, and precise LiDAR while minimizing computational complexity.
technical.why: Multi-sensor fusion is critical for building safer perception stacks that withstand adverse weather.

technical.title: CLOCs-R framework integrates radar evidence for long-range 3D object detection
technical.summary: CLOCs-R extends candidate-level fusion by accumulating radar sweeps and appending Doppler and range features to camera-LiDAR pairs to improve long-range object detection where camera and LiDAR evidence degrade.
technical.why: It directly addresses long-range detection bottlenecks in autonomous driving perception.

technical.title: Real-time CUDA solver brings Hamilton-Jacobi reachability onboard robot control loops
technical.summary: A new CUDA implementation of the level-set Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs solver runs fast enough inside robot control loops to provide deterministic safety guarantees and certified backward reachable tubes for robotic systems.
technical.why: Provides an essential deterministic safety layer with formal guarantees for probabilistic AI policies.

technical.title: Study evaluates multimodal agentic reinforcement learning through video editing tasks
technical.summary: Researchers explore how fine-grained credit assignment impacts multimodal agents using video editing as a testbed, creating four task types that reflect real-world workflows with varying complexities and interactions.
technical.why: Understanding when process rewards help improves training for multimodal agents handling complex, long-horizon tasks.

technical.title: DiMuRe framework uses diagnosis-guided multilevel recovery for robust robotic task execution
technical.summary: DiMuRe combines phase-specific evidence and method preconditions to select program reuse or predefined recovery skills when disturbances invalidate robot actions, using MLLMs to generate corrective code from images and feedback.
technical.why: Improves the reliability and adaptability of robotic agents when facing unexpected environmental disturbances.

technical.title: CoReMatch provides recurrent continuous coordinate refinement for real-time robotic feature matching
technical.summary: CoReMatch replaces fixed-grid confidence maps with a recurrent framework that refines feature correspondences directly in continuous coordinate space across iterations, supporting localization and SLAM.
technical.why: Enables more precise real-time feature matching for robotic localization and navigation without high-resolution grids.

technical.title: NVIDIA utilizes AI agents to streamline GPU cluster factory operations
technical.summary: As GPU clusters scale across compute, network, hardware, and scheduling, site reliability engineers face complex operational dashboards requiring automated agentic intervention.
technical.why: Illustrates how AI agents manage massive infrastructure bottlenecks in large-scale AI factories.

technical.title: Factorized MLLM embeddings improve composed image retrieval through decoupled comprehension
technical.summary: FactEmbed decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings to better utilize multimodal large language models for composed image retrieval, resolving visual modifications explicitly.
technical.why: Enhances multimodal retrieval performance by better exploiting compositional understanding in MLLMs.

technical.title: ScienceVision benchmark evaluates AI observation and reasoning for scientific 3D data
technical.summary: ScienceVision is a cross-domain benchmark for expert-level visual question answering on scientific 3D data, addressing the limitation of existing benchmarks that largely focus on 2D images and text.
technical.why: Provides standard evaluation protocols for cross-disciplinary AI reasoning in scientific 3D environments.

technical.title: OpenAI autonomous pipeline finds and patches Linux kernel vulnerabilities
technical.summary: OpenAI constructed an autonomous pipeline that successfully identified, validated, and generated software patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.
technical.why: Highlights the growing capability of autonomous systems to handle complex software security tasks.

business.title: Qualcomm targets AI data centers as smartphone sales drop 20 percent
business.summary: With smartphone sales tanking by around 20 percent compared to 2025, Qualcomm plans to enter the AI data center business via partnerships with Amazon and Meta.
business.why: It highlights hardware shifts towards AI infrastructure amid consumer device slowdowns.

business.title: AMD data center revenue nearly doubles driven by AI chips
business.summary: AMD reported better-than-expected third-quarter results, driven by booming sales of AI chips, and CEO Su expects growth to accelerate.
business.why: Strong financial results signal continued high demand for AI hardware components.

business.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles valuation to $16B
business.summary: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3 billion round led by Bessemer as demand for AI inference surges.
business.why: Valuation surges for inference startups highlight critical scaling and deployment bottlenecks.

business.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
business.summary: Meta acquired the startup, which enables software engineers to deploy teams of agents to work on multiple project aspects simultaneously.
business.why: M&A activity in agentic coding tools signals major tech giants' strategic priorities.

business.title: Crunchbase Data: Less Than 2% Of 2026 Venture Funding Went To Post-Election Red States
business.summary: So far this year, less than 2% of all startup investment has gone to companies in post-election red states, a share that is much smaller than in years’ past due to five states shifting to purple in the most recent electi

business.title: Snap shares fall over 10% on third-quarter revenue miss
business.summary: Snap misses on revenue and daily active users in third-quarter earnings reported Wednesday.

business.title: Hyperscalers and Apple surge after election results remove investor uncertainty
business.summary: Apple, Amazon, Google, Meta and Microsoft stock was up after the midterms, while stocks tied to Trump advisor Elon Musk and data centers fell on Wednesday.

business.title: DeepSeek raises record-setting $15.9 billion as global venture funding hits $59B
business.summary: Global venture funding in October reached $59 billion, marking a 45% jump from a year earlier, largely driven by China's largest startup deal ever.
business.why: Massive capital injections into foundational AI startups shape the competitive market landscape.

business.title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
business.summary: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $360 million for a new flagship fund and another $130 million for a separate investment vehicle.

business.title: Most Venture Capital Is Going To Companies That Are Founded Or Led By Billionaires
business.summary: More than half of all seed- through growth-stage venture capital raised in the U.S. so far in 2026 went to seven companies founded or led by men who are already billionaires. Together, these companies raised more than $2

models.title: Idol Turns a Single Image Into a 3D Gaussian Splat
models.summary: Idol converts one picture of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat containing up to a million Gaussians, including unseen sides, running in under two seconds on consumer GPUs.
models.why: It enables rapid 3D asset generation directly from single 2D images for computer vision pipelines.

models.title: Mistral Large 4 Unveiled as Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts
models.summary: Mistral Large 4 is a 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal model with 49 billion active parameters per token, outperforming closed models on visual grounding and supporting 160+ languages.
models.why: It delivers frontier-level multimodal and visual grounding capabilities for complex AI workflows.

models.title: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder Explores Small Models for 3D Scenes
models.summary: CCORE released an independent fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B focused on general-purpose coding and generating interactive 3D scenes with Three.js, featuring optional vision support.
models.why: It demonstrates the feasibility of small language models for specialized 3D scene generation tasks.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe for Offline Audio
models.summary: NVIDIA launched Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B, an open-weight speech model supporting 40 languages, one-hour recordings, and a 65k-token context using a hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture.
models.why: This model provides an efficient, local transcription tool with broad language support for audio processing workflows.

models.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Launches With Multimodal Agentic Capabilities
models.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight multimodal agentic model featuring a 1-million-token context window, 2.8T total parameters, and improvements in coding, 3D creation, and research.
models.why: It provides advanced long-context multimodal reasoning and 3D creation support.

models.title: Pika H3 Flex Released for Professional Video Generation
models.summary: Pika H3 Flex is a post-trained video model providing synchronized audio in six sampling steps, supporting up to 12 reference inputs, and local open-weight inference at native 480p/768p.
models.why: It gives creators precise, controllable video generation tools with multi-reference input support.
